module counter_03 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input en,
  output [3:0] bcd_ones,
  output [3:0] bcd_tens,
  output carry_out
);

  reg [3:0] bcd_ones_reg;
  reg [3:0] bcd_tens_reg;
  reg [3:0] ones_next;
  reg [3:0] tens_next;

  always_comb begin
    ones_next = bcd_ones_reg;
    tens_next = bcd_tens_reg;
    if (en) begin
      if (bcd_ones_reg == 4'd9) begin
        ones_next = 4'd0;
        if (bcd_tens_reg == 4'd9) begin
          tens_next = 4'd0;
        end else begin
          tens_next = bcd_tens_reg + 4'd1;
        end
      end else begin
        ones_next = bcd_ones_reg + 4'd1;
      end
    end
  end

  always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      bcd_ones_reg <= 4'd0;
      bcd_tens_reg <= 4'd0;
    end else begin
      bcd_ones_reg <= ones_next;
      bcd_tens_reg <= tens_next;
    end
  end

  assign bcd_ones = bcd_ones_reg;
  assign bcd_tens = bcd_tens_reg;
  assign carry_out = (bcd_ones_reg == 4'd9) && (bcd_tens_reg == 4'd9) && en;

endmodule
